senses.zh_definition: 专名用法：Belicoff 是电影《Hitman》（2007）中人物使用的姓氏。此用例不构成其为马来语普通词的证据。
senses.en_definition: A surname used by fictional characters in the film Hitman (2007); not verified as a Malay common word.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang digunakan oleh watak fiksyen dalam filem Hitman (2007); belum disahkan sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu. Huraian ini bukan takrif rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 此处仅记录已核实的专名用法，不推定输入必然指向该电影。电影官方宣传资料列有 Belicoff 和 Udre Belicoff。以下搭配及情境句为原创教学示例，不是已证实的高频搭配或语料引文。来源：[Hitman 官方宣传资料](https://medias.unifrance.org/medias/206/123/31694/presse/hitman-presskit-french.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: Belicoff is documented as a character name in the official publicity material for the 2007 film Hitman. The cast list includes Belicoff and Udre Belicoff, establishing a fictional naming context rather than a Malay lexical meaning. This evidence does not establish the surname's deeper linguistic origin or any borrowing into Malay. Its presence in the supplied vocabulary list remains unexplained. Source: [Official Hitman press kit](https://medias.unifrance.org/medias/206/123/31694/presse/hitman-presskit-french.pdf).
